session_notes: No audio. Wrong target (Fat first then Label). No emit in many build cycles. Some graph use. Depth-3 built without threshold reasoning documentation. Same-class leaf label assignment on final model (MCR=0 artifact, not by understanding).

B3.note: Fat dragged as target. Tree emitted with Fat as target (unlike Calvin who corrected before emit). B3-A1 confirmed. The tree emitting with wrong target is documented — this is a stronger wrong-target observation than most.

B5.note: Final model: both leaf nodes assigned same class label. This produced MCR=0 artifact. Evidence suggests label assignment was not understood — B5-A1 (distinguishing two outcomes) cannot be confirmed. not_observed.
